question:
**Case Study: Construction Engineering — Crane Movement**

A construction company is tasked to lift a heavy steel beam from point A (with position vector $\vec{OA} = 5\hat{i} + 3\hat{j} + 0\hat{k}$) to the top of a building at point B ($\vec{OB} = 15\hat{i} + 19\hat{j} + 15\hat{k}$). The crane cable pulls along a vector $\vec{F} = 2\hat{i} + 3\hat{j} + 6\hat{k}$ (in kN). The movement is assisted by a guide rope exerting a force $\vec{G} = -\hat{i} + 2\hat{j} + 3\hat{k}$ (in kN).

(a) Find the displacement vector $\vec{AB}$.

(b) Compute the resultant force acting (vector sum of $\vec{F}$ and $\vec{G}$).

(c) Find the magnitude of the displacement.

(d) Calculate the work done by the resultant force in moving the beam from A to B.

(e) If the vector representing the rooftop surface is $\vec{u} = 4\hat{i} - 4\hat{j} + \hat{k}$, find a unit vector perpendicular to both $\vec{AB}$ and $\vec{u}$.

(f) Compute the area of the parallelogram formed by vectors $\vec{AB}$ and $\vec{u}$.
explanation:
(a) Displacement vector:

$\vec{AB} = \vec{OB} - \vec{OA}$

$= (15\hat{i} + 19\hat{j} + 15\hat{k}) - (5\hat{i} + 3\hat{j} + 0\hat{k})$

$= (15-5)\hat{i} + (19-3)\hat{j} + (15-0)\hat{k}$

$= 10\hat{i} + 16\hat{j} + 15\hat{k}$

(b) Resultant force:

$\vec{R} = \vec{F} + \vec{G}$

$= (2\hat{i} + 3\hat{j} + 6\hat{k}) + (-\hat{i} + 2\hat{j} + 3\hat{k})$

$= (2-1)\hat{i} + (3+2)\hat{j} + (6+3)\hat{k}$

$= 1\hat{i} + 5\hat{j} + 9\hat{k}$

(c) Magnitude of displacement:

$|\vec{AB}| = \sqrt{10^2 + 16^2 + 15^2}$

$= \sqrt{100 + 256 + 225}$

$= \sqrt{581}$

$|\vec{AB}| \approx 24.10$ units

(d) Work done:

$W = \vec{R} \cdot \vec{AB}$

$= (1\hat{i} + 5\hat{j} + 9\hat{k}) \cdot (10\hat{i} + 16\hat{j} + 15\hat{k})$

$= (1)(10) + (5)(16) + (9)(15)$

$= 10 + 80 + 135$

$= 225$

Work done is $225$ kJ (since force in kN, displacement in m).

(e) Unit vector perpendicular to both $\vec{AB}$ and $\vec{u}$:

First, $\vec{n} = \vec{AB} \times \vec{u}$

Set up determinant:

$\vec{n} = | \begin{array}{ccc} \hat{i} & \hat{j} & \hat{k} \\ 10 & 16 & 15 \\ 4 & -4 & 1 \end{array} |$

$= \hat{i}[(16 \cdot 1)-(15 \cdot -4)] - \hat{j}[(10 \cdot 1)-(15 \cdot 4)] + \hat{k}[(10 \cdot -4)-(16 \cdot 4)]$

$= \hat{i}[16 + 60] - \hat{j}[10 - 60] + \hat{k}[-40 - 64]$

$= 76\hat{i} + 50\hat{j} - 104\hat{k}$

Now, magnitude:

$|\vec{n}| = \sqrt{76^2 + 50^2 + 104^2}$

$= \sqrt{5776 + 2500 + 10816}$

$= \sqrt{19092}$

$\approx 138.24$

Unit vector $\hat{n} = \dfrac{76}{138.24}\hat{i} + \dfrac{50}{138.24}\hat{j} - \dfrac{104}{138.24}\hat{k}$.

(f) Area of parallelogram:

$|\vec{AB} \times \vec{u}| = 138.24$ units².

options.A:
(a) $\vec{AB}=10\hat{i}+16\hat{j}+15\hat{k}$
(b) $\vec{R}=\hat{i}+5\hat{j}+9\hat{k}$

(d) Work done $=225$ kJ
(e) Unit vector $=\frac{76\hat{i}+50\hat{j}+104\hat{k}}{\sqrt{19092}}$
